title: A newcomer's life: a lean land and a second pack
about: As `life`, with berry bushes at 30% of the island's density and a second bold pack of five wolves ranging 120-200 m from the arrival point (the seed's `packs`), beside the shipped pack of four at 40-75 m.
gradient: Survive the first nights on a wolf road -> find safety (the walled town and its gates, a fire, a shelter) -> feed yourself where berries are scarce (hunt with the bow, fish, trap, or live off the town's gardens and stores) -> make a place that holds.

packs.name: the wolves of the town road
